FULL TEXT:
THE HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD
NOTICE
No.C.0305/2026/02
Date: 2 7/08/2026
In pursuance to the provisions contained in “The High
Court of Gujarat (Designation of Senior Advocates) Rules, 2025”
(Amended as on 14.05.2026) (“the Rules, 2025”), Notice
No.C.0305/2026/01 dated 06/07/2026 inviting applications for
designation of Senior Advocate, for the High Court of Gujarat, was
published.
In response thereto, 22 applications seeking designation as
Senior Advocate have been received by the Secretariat from the
Applicants mentioned in the list annexed hereto.
The written suggestions/views of other stakeholders as per
Rule 4(x) of the Rules, 2025 are invited in respect of the
applications for designation of Senior Advocates. The
suggestions/views shall be submitted by post or through registered
e-mail ar-cbranch@gujarat.gov.in (attachment should be in pdf
form only) on or before 18.09.2026. The suggestions/views shall
bear the name and full address of the sender and shall be
addressed to the undersigned.
Anonymous petitions/representations/views will not be
entertained. The Suggestions/views submitted beyond the said
stipulated date and time shall not be entertained.
Y ob
(Sunil B. Lodha)
Addl. Registrar-cum-Chief P.S. to
Hon'ble the Chief Justice
